title: First Laugh
desc: It was four small sounds that stopped our hearts completely. The best sound either of us has ever heard.
story: Dad was making ridiculous faces at you — honestly a little concerning how far he was willing to go — when you suddenly made this little 'heh heh heh heh' sound. We froze. We stared at each other. And then we both burst into tears. We tried for 45 minutes to make you do it again.
